product: Wayfinder (project dashboard and Tool Registry), repository keyona-rerev/wayfinder
how_to_find: The repository has no git tags. Open your fork on GitHub and read the date of the newest commit that came from keyona-rerev/wayfinder. Compare it with the dates below. For the database, compare your Supabase tables with supabase/schema.sql in the fork.

versions.title: Board gated on completed analysis
versions.summary: VERIFY: inferred from commit dates. Newest commit b425be3 (2026-07-05). The main board now lists only projects with analysis_status complete. Awaiting Analysis merges unanalyzed projects and repos without a project. A migration script for the ReRev Labs Tool Registry was added (do not run it).

changes.text: Main board shows only projects whose analysis_status is complete (commit b425be3).
Script scripts/migrate_tool_registry.py for the ReRev Labs own Tool Registry rows. It is not for client use (commit e178975).

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork
upgrade_steps.text: On your fork page on GitHub, choose Sync fork, then Update branch. Check that assets/config.js still holds your own values.

versions.title: First build of the dashboard and its seven modules
versions.summary: VERIFY: inferred from commit dates. The repository was created 2026-07-04 and 13 commits followed the same day. The last change to supabase/schema.sql was commit 100dae9 (2026-07-04). The schema file lists its own migration names in its header.

changes.text: Interface with Kanban, list, grid and gallery views (commit 4e47f70).
Session Log, Rubric with evolution log, Architecture Map, Consideration Mode, Tech Stack and Deep Test modules.
Analysis status tracking with stages and elapsed time (commit ca4ff3a).
Kanban columns are Building, Live, Parked and Blocked (commit 100dae9).

upgrade_steps.title: Check the database
upgrade_steps.text: Compare your Supabase tables and the status check on the projects table with supabase/schema.sql in your fork. Ask ReRev Labs before you change an existing table.
